items.text: Five questions decide the taxes on each line, and the trace is stored on the line.
Several taxes on a line, compounding, prices with tax included, and three ways to round.
Tax groups with dated versions, item tax categories, and rules by place, buyer and item.
Country presets for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, the UK, India and the EU states, and a US sandbox with base rates. Each preset records its sources and is not tax advice.
The till and the online shop read the same decision as the back office.
Line overrides only with permission, with warnings to acknowledge.
“Remember this” turns an override into a proposed rule.
Tax changes that the rules would block are saved only with an approval.
A warning when you are registered for VAT and no rule applies.
“Test a sale” to see the taxes a sale would get before you make it.
Purchases split into the tax you recover and the part that is a cost, with reverse charge.
Withholding suggested or enforced at payment and at receipt.
Credit notes carry the taxes of the original document.
A VAT return report and your VAT position, with the filing day.
The tax return laid out box by box.
Schedules of exempt and zero-rated sales.

faq.q: Can I see why a tax was charged?
faq.a: Yes. Each line keeps the trace of how its taxes were decided, so you can open it and read the reasons.

faq.q: Does Clafina file my VAT return?
faq.a: No. It prepares the VAT return report from the ledger and shows the day it is due. You file it yourself with those figures.

faq.q: Can someone change the tax on a line?
faq.a: Only people with permission, and they see warnings to acknowledge first. “Remember this” can turn the change into a proposed rule.
